Name: Baily Stevenson
Badge: Everyday Sparks 2.0
Which strategy from this module (Daily Schedule, Take a Line for a Walk or Interpreting Visual Texts) feels most immediately usable in your teaching context? Why?:

I plan to use visual texts in my teaching. I'm actually incorporating it now in my digital literacy unit to teach data manipulation. I think it is a great way to make students think critically about data that is presented to them.

What other strategies or approaches have you used to engage your students in routine writing over the course of this school year? What, if any, challenges have you encountered in engaging students in sustained routine writing?:
I've used the hexagonal thinking technique with my students to connect main ideas in a novel. However, I was gone, and they just filled stuff in with little thought about how it connected. I think it would have worked better had I assigned it as group work while I was there.
